subject: Preserve original fd blocking state in TLS I/O operations (#1298)
reason: The change only alters TLS synchronous I/O (connTLSSyncWrite/Read/ReadLine in src/tls.c, compiled only with BUILD_TLS and exercised only on a TLS connection doing blocking I/O, such as a TLS replication handshake or MIGRATE over TLS). The fuzzer cannot open any TLS connection: builds are made with plain make (no BUILD_TLS), tls-port is rejected in every server_config, CONFIG SET of a port is refused inside compared sequences, no component provisions certificates, and all harness clients and private compare servers use plain TCP or unix sockets. The anet.c part is a behaviour-preserving refacto
